pick.name: Dodo Payments usage-based billing
pick.what: Meters (count/sum/max/last), event ingestion API, credits, LLM token ingestion blueprints
pick.why: Metering + invoicing + tax in your MoR: no separate billing system
pick.free_limits: +0.5% on usage/subscription billing on top of MoR rate; events POST /events/ingest with event_id, customer_id, event_name

alts.name: Polar usage-based billing
alts.free_limits: No separate subscription fee on Starter+; docs flagged parts as alpha/new; Polar doesn't block usage past credits (you must)

alts.name: Lago (self-host)
alts.free_limits: Self-host free; AGPL-3.0 (LICENSE fetched); payments still need a processor
alts.install: git clone https://github.com/getlago/lago && docker compose up

candidates.name: OpenMeter
candidates.verdict: Apache-2.0, acquired by Kong Sept 2025 (folding into Konnect)

decision: Keep metering in the MoR until pricing is stable: one ledger, one tax engine. Pull in Lago/OpenMeter only if you need processor-independent metering across multiple MoRs.

verify.note: Doc confirms meters count/sum/max/last and POST /events/ingest with event_id, customer_id, event_name, metadata; +0.5% usage surcharge is on the pricing page. dodopayments SDK 2.58.0 (2026-10-28, Apache-2.0) confirmed. Lago AGPL-3.0, v1.55.0 2026-10-07 confirmed.
